content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: spike in batcher_request_queue_len on cluster-prod-west, sustained > 1200 for 3m. 90th token latency rising. Auto-scaling didn't kick due to GPU headroom constraint.
michael: oncall here, looking. any customer-facing errors?
sara: a few 503s from the api-gateway -> batcher timeouts, mostly on /chat/stream endpoints. Not widespread but a couple enterprise customers hitting it hard.
michael: ok - prioritizing live mitigation. hypothesis: continuous batcher building very slowly for short inputs, causing queue pileup. want to trade p50 for throughput.
deepak: agreed. recommend: 1) enable rate cap for anonymous /low-prio routes 2) bump continuous_batch.max_wait_ms from 50 -> 200 3) temporarily disable streaming on non-critical routes.
michael: +1. can someone apply those quickly? I can do the config change for batcher. jess, can you flip the featureflag for streaming?
jess: on it, toggling feature flag now for routes: /chat/assist, /chat/notify (non-prod-like flows).
ops-bot: Executing feature flag change: FLAG:disable_streaming_noncritical = true -> success (req_id: ff-7891).
michael: applying batcher change: patching runtime config. cmd:
```
curl -X POST https://ops.internal/api/v1/configs/runtime -H 'Authorization: Bearer ****' -d '{"continuous_batch.max_wait_ms":"200", "continuous_batch.max_batch_size":"128"}'
```
michael: done, pushed to prod-west, rolling to other zones as safe. ops-bot, confirm rollout?
ops-bot: rollout initiated to prod-west pool (nodes: g4-12), change id cfg-3419, progress: 1/6 nodes applied.
sara: applied on 3 nodes, queue len dropping to ~400. p95 token latency up ~120ms but customers are no longer getting 503s.
deepak: good. also applied temporary rate cap: limit=30rps per IP on /embeddings and /chat/generate for low-tier keys. enacted via ratecap service.
andre: FYI, telemetry shows top offender is customer 'AtlasMobile' spike at 2.1k concurrent short chats. ops - did we contact account team?
sara: pinged acct @lia already, asking if they can throttle spike on their side. lia: acknowledged, sending customer message to temp throttle non-essential flows.
michael: summarizing for handoff: incident started with batcher queue spike due to many short-shot requests. Mitigations: increased continuous_batch.max_wait_ms -> larger batches (+throughput, +p50), raised max_batch_size, disabled noncritical streaming, applied rate caps on low-tier routes and per-IP. Immediate customer impact: fewer 503s, single-request latencies increased ~100-250ms. Severity: P2.
jess: capturing runbook notes in incident doc: https://docs.redwood/incident/INC-3419 (create stub).
ops-bot: telemetry after mitigation: batch_queue_len 350 -> 220 over 5m, avg GPU utilization 78%, pod restarts none.
michael: great. lia, continue comms with AtlasMobile and two other affected customers (RetailX, FinSolve). Recommend offering to throttle background jobs on their side for 30m.
lia: will do. drafting note now.
sara: leaving this in stable mitigated state. raising a follow-up action: evaluate continuous_batch defaults for short-input-dominated workloads and consider adaptive wait window (based on incoming rate).
deepak: +1 for adaptive window. we'll schedule a spike test.
michael: handing off to jess for night coverage. jess - all the relevant knobs and links in runbook, watch queue and p95 in the next hour.
jess: got it. taking over. will monitor and escalate if queue > 500 or 503s reappear. :thumbsup:
michael: thanks team :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident INC-3419 transitioned to status: mitigated by michael at 3419876610
